Subject: Customer spotlight: quick Capterra endorsement?

Hi Alyssa —

Quick ask: would LumenIQ be open to a very short public endorsement on Capterra? We’re trying to capture a handful of concise customer perspectives (2–3 sentences) that highlight the product impact — nothing formal or time consuming.

If you’re open to it we can:
- Share a one-click Capterra link to submit a short rating and 2-line comment
- Offer a $75 e-gift (Amazon/Tango) as a thank-you once posted

I’m cc’ing Marissa from our advocacy team and she’ll handle fulfillment. I’ve attached a quick one-pager that explains the process and the wording that usually works. No case study commitment required.

If this sounds reasonable, would you be able to submit by the end of next week? If not, happy to take a two-line quote I can paste in for you.

Thanks,
Rohan Mehta

rohan_mehta@redwood.com

Hi Rohan —

Thanks for the note and congrats on the rollout — the team has definitely seen the latency/cost wins. I’m happy to help, but a couple quick clarifying Qs before I post publicly:

1) How will Redwood use the quote (marketing, product page, press)?
2) Is there any need for legal sign-off on our side? We have a compliance reviewer who prefers to see the exact comment if it’s going to be quoted beyond Capterra.

If you can share a short usage note I’ll run it past internal counsel and circle back.

—Alyssa
Alyssa Park
VP Product Operations, LumenIQ
alyssa.park@lumeniq.com

Alyssa —

Appreciate the careful approach. Short answers:
- Use: primary use is the Capterra profile and automated syndication to site listings; secondarily we may feature a short excerpt (2 lines max) on our marketing pages or in sales decks, but only with your permission on the exact text.
- Legal: you do not need formal contractual sign-off for a short Capterra submission. If your counsel prefers to pre-approve the exact wording, we’re happy to share the comment before wider marketing use.

If easier: here’s a suggested 2-line comment you can paste and edit: "Redwood Inference brought predictable latency and lower token costs to our customer-facing features. Integration was straightforward and the team responded quickly when we tuned batching for our high-throughput routes."

Capterra submit link: https://www.capterra.com/r/review/lumeniq/submit

Marissa will send the gift card once you confirm the post or send the quote you want us to use.

Thanks again — let me know what works and I’ll wait on Marissa for fulfillment.

—Rohan
